learned.claim: v0.6.7: Startup profile ships seven founder-ops roles (growth, content, sales-gtm, support, finance-ops, legal-ops, IR) under two iron laws - draft-never-send and the honesty law beyond code. Role count 26.
The version-sync lint refused a carrier bump made before its CHANGELOG entry existed - the gate caught its own author mid-release, order is entry-then-bump (or same commit).
Startup roles are all main-thread: everything they produce points outward and external sends belong to the human - the same reasoning that keeps Release Manager out of subagents.
